verdict.summary: The change correctly strengthens the provider-label regression from a prose/textual claim into a non-vacuous execution test. The harness obtains LABELS_JSON from the actual meta step env mapping, renders the relevant GitHub Actions expressions, executes the real delimited predicate, and verifies both command-substitution and backtick payloads remain data. Its positive control runs the same payloads through the former inline join form and requires canary creation, so a renderer that merely neutralizes expressions cannot pass. The env reader and expression renderer fail closed on missing, ambiguous, empty, or invalid inputs, and the exact LABELS_JSON expression plus absence of label-context interpolation in consuming run scripts are pinned. The workflow itself only gains explanatory comments and does not weaken permissions, routing, gates, or trust checks.
